blocks.x: Pharma's frontier is acceleration under validation: discovery simulation, trial design, recruitment and pharmacovigilance all carry GxP duty. Companies that industrialize evidence pipelines compress the costly middle of the pipeline without compromising the audit.

The workflows we industrialize here: Discovery screening, Protocol eligibility matching, Pharmacovigilance intake, RWE assembly, Lab data governance. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.

items: Target and molecule screening compute-bound; HPC and emerging compute underused.
Eligibility matching against EHR remains chart review; trials miss enrollment windows.
Adverse-event intake spans channels and languages; case assembly is manual and backlogs breach reporting clocks.
Real-world evidence pipelines rebuilt per study; regulatory-grade provenance thin.
Compound data and trial designs attract state-grade interest; labs run loose estates.
Quantum simulation promising but unbenchmarked; classical baselines unclear.

blocks.x: How we help — five priority capabilities

items: GPU/HPC-optimized screening pipelines with reproducibility — throughput up 2-5x
protocol criteria translated to EHR queries with evidence — matching at 10x manual rate
AE cases assembled from channel intake with MedDRA coding — assembly effort halved
quantum vs. DFT benchmarked with verdicts — honest verdicts with triggers
classification-aware controls for compound/trial data — state-grade interest deterred
